title: ONE RARITY PER GUN
why: His order 10-29: get rid of the lower rarity of any weapons. The six affected guns retain only their former higher colour, 1.25 times damage and 1.5 times value under the original permanent id. Old higher ids migrate before validation; stash cells, locks, kit picks, wear and Forge marks survive. Watch: each gun has one rarity; the guns that had two are always the better one. These guns now always hit 25 percent harder than their old common find, including guns carried by pillagers. Watch both windows for matching gun colours and saved loadouts. Pickup code, loot sounds and loot rows are untouched.
now: Each gun has one rarity; guns that had two are always the better one.
